findings.evidence: Six links named only 'Details' (to #/tools/chatgpt, #/tools/claude, ...) and six buttons named only 'Add to compare' (dom-1440.json). The card is a div, not a list item or article, so there is no programmatically determined context tying each to its tool.
findings.after:
Details about ChatGPT and aria-label="Add ChatGPT to compare"; or wrap each card in
  • /
    with the h3 id.
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 2.4.4 Link Purpose (In Context): a screen-reader links list shows six identical 'Details' entries.

findings.where: fixed 'Made in Bolt' badge, bottom right at every width
findings.evidence: focus.json stops 14 ('Build a SaaS product') and 38 ('Details' on ElevenLabs) are covered; the badge sits over the last column of every grid in tiles 1440-00 and 375-00. The sweep flagged the two stops; the cause is the third-party badge, which has no visible dismiss persistence.
findings.after: Remove the builder badge in production, or add scroll-padding-bottom equal to its height so focused items scroll clear.

findings.evidence: Two adjacent controls both named 'Compare' go to #/compare (nav link and the outlined button with icon). Current page 'Home' is shown only by a pale blue fill; check for aria-current.
findings.after: Drop the duplicate or name it by its state ('Compare (0)'); add aria-current="page" to the active nav link.
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.3.1 Info and Relationships / 1.4.1 Use of Color for the current-page cue; duplicate names add noise to the links list.

strengths: Focus order follows visual order: header, hero CTAs, goal grid row by row, tool cards left to right, CTA (focus.json y sequence is monotonic per row).
Icon-only controls have names ('Toggle menu', 'Add to compare', 'Twitter', 'GitHub', 'LinkedIn'); lang and landmarks (header, nav, main, footer) present.
not_investigated: Keyboard operation of the mobile menu and the quiz flow (no live session).
Forms and errors: no forms on the captured route.

disputed: none of the sampled sweep Floor hits (12px #94a3b8 trust chips 2.56:1, 'GP' white on #10a37f 3.20:1) look like false positives; the 'GP' avatars are decorative initials beside the real name and could be aria-hidden, which would remove them from scope.
